streak_assessment: Seven consecutive scientifically completed candidates have now failed to displace the exp-0089 champion (exp-0090 king-danger 0.508, exp-0091 passed pawns 0.531, exp-0092 rook file activity 0.492, exp-0093 doubled/isolated pawns 0.484, exp-0094 in-tree repetition-draw scoring 0.531, exp-0095 lone-king coordinate mop-up 0.461, exp-0096 halfmove-clock progress gradient 0.539). This is well past the handoff stop rule's numeric threshold of five. Two whole mechanism directions are now saturated: (a) the search / move-ordering / quiescence / time-management family (roughly exp-0048 through exp-0088 plus exp-0094: killer/history/TT-best ordering, aspiration windows, guarded null-move, bounded check extensions/evasions, forcing-check priority, mate-distance scoring, quiet promotions and delta pruning in quiescence, timeout unwinding, stalemate repair, ordering-key micro-opt, halfmove-clock TT bucketing, clock-allocation tuning, in-tree repetition scoring) with no untried, materially distinct member; and (b) the self-contained hand-weighted leaf-evaluation-term family, which after exp-0089's accepted mobility term has now absorbed a king-safety term, a passed-pawn term, a rook-open-file term, a pawn-structure term, a coordinate mop-up/king-drive term, and a halfmove-clock progress gradient, every one inconclusive. exp-0096 was explicitly nominated by the previous audit as "the last self-contained evaluation idea," and its own evidence confirms the prediction: 25 of 64 games still drawn by threefold repetition and all 17 losses still checkmates, so the leaf-evaluation gradient it injected did not move the dominant failure mode. exp-0095's mop-up mechanism was tested but under a bare-king gate that fired in almost no games; widening that gate is a threshold change barred by the anti-tuning rule, not a new hypothesis. The task's other suggested directions do not survive scrutiny: bishop-pair is another middlegame positional scalar in an already-saturated family and does not touch endgame conversion; a small opening book is directly adversarial to the model-move-ablation gate (it would make the real and zeroed-model agents play identical book moves, collapsing the 28/32 move differences toward the failure line) and the retained games show the losses and draws arising in conversion, not the opening; persisted cross-move search state is a search-family change whose only benefit is effective depth, and the confirmed cause of the conversion failures is a horizon 15-25 plies short of the mate, which more depth cannot bridge. Hand-editing weights/model.json endgame piece-square values is crude, risks the "trained model materially determines evaluation" constraint, and only supplies a gradient the material term already swamps once a side is up a rook or more. No materially different, well-motivated, self-contained experiment remains in any direction.
recurring_failure_modes: Non-forced threefold-repetition draws from winning or clearly better positions: 25 of 64 games in exp-0096 (32 of 64 in exp-0095). Retained PGNs show the engine reaching a decisive material edge (e.g. exp-0096 game 1, White up a knight in a rook ending after 44. Rhxh6) and then playing spite checks or piece shuffles (45. Rhg6+ Kf8 46. Rgf6+ Kg7 47. Rg6+ Kf8 48. Rgf6+ Kg7 1/2-1/2) instead of converting, because with a large material lead every legal move saturates the leaf evaluation at roughly the same winning score and alpha-beta has no tie-break toward progress.

All decisive losses are checkmates (17 of 17 in exp-0096) reached by long enemy king hunts after the candidate simplifies into a passive, defensible-looking but lost endgame; slight skew toward losing as Black (about 10 of 17).

Whole opening pairs drawn by both colours (open-game, english, reti, kings-indian, dutch, nimzo-indian and others in exp-0095/0096), indicating the draw problem is structural to endgame/technical-position evaluation rather than opening-specific.

The trained tapered piece-square model has no move-counter, king-tropism, or explicit progress feature and an identical PST for a piece or king shuffled between two squares, so the shuffle-versus-progress distinction is invisible at the leaf and unreachable by deeper search; every closed-form hand-weighted term tried to inject that gradient (mobility, king safety, passed pawns, rook files, pawn structure, in-tree repetition, coordinate mop-up, halfmove clock) has left the repetition-draw and king-hunt-loss counts essentially unchanged.
audit_summary: Champion is agent.py at commit 4a0c988 (recorded as exp-0089): a PVS/LMR negamax with exchange-aware capture ordering and losing-capture pruning inside a depth-3 quiescence, a depth-keyed transposition table on (transposition_key, halfmove_clock, depth) with a 50k-entry flush, partial root-iteration salvage on timeout, a cheap fast-draw path (_forced_draw = halfmove_clock>=100 OR is_repetition(3) OR insufficient material), and an iterative-deepening loop under a conservative wall-clock budget, over a tapered learned piece-square model plus the accepted fixed 3 cp/net-square mobility term (exp-0089) and a flat castling-rights scalar. The batch just run produced exp-0096, the previous audit's chosen direction: a bounded (<=~28 model-unit) halfmove-clock progress gradient folded into _model_evaluate, gated to reduced-material (phase <= 10), materially decided (|material_diff| >= 300) endgames, penalising the side ahead and rewarding the side behind as the 50-move counter climbs. Result: inconclusive sequential paired arena, 22 wins / 25 draws / 17 losses, score 0.539, 90% CI [0.467, 0.610]; CI green, model-move ablation 28 of 32 differences (unchanged from exp-0095, minimum 8), reliability stress green (init 0.22 s, worst move 0.95 s against the 2.25 s ceiling at the 120 s clock, required_failures 0), ruff, mypy, smoke, resources and policy all green, zero agent failures. Not promoted, so the term is not in the champion. Draw terminations: 25 of 64 threefold repetition; loss breakdown: all 17 losses checkmate. This is the seventh consecutive scientific non-improvement since exp-0089 (0.508, 0.531, 0.492, 0.484, 0.531, 0.461, 0.539). Decision: STOP with stop_condition scientific_saturation. The handoff stop rule is met on both limbs: at least five consecutive completed candidates have failed since the newest promotion, and after a full evidence audit no materially different, well-motivated, self-contained experiment remains. The search/ordering/quiescence/time-management family is exhausted; the self-contained hand-weighted leaf-evaluation-term family is exhausted (mobility accepted, then king safety, passed pawns, rook files, pawn structure, coordinate mop-up and halfmove clock all inconclusive); the dominant failure — endgame/technical-conversion repetition draws and king-hunt checkmate losses caused by a flat leaf evaluation once a side is materially ahead — has had three consecutive direct attempts (exp-0094, exp-0095, exp-0096) with no movement in the repetition-draw or loss counts. exp-0095's mop-up mechanism was tested only under a bare-king gate that essentially never fired; widening that gate is a threshold change barred by the anti-tuning rule. The task's alternative suggestions were evaluated and rejected: bishop-pair belongs to the saturated middlegame-scalar family and does not address conversion; a small opening book is adversarial to the model-move-ablation gate and the losses/draws are in conversion not the opening; persisted cross-move search state only buys effective depth, and the converting mate is 15-25 plies past the horizon. No infrastructure, auth, rules or reproducibility blocker exists — all gates are green. Escalation for the human: the confirmed fix requires an offline retrain of weights/model.json with trained positional and endgame features (king activity/centralisation, king tropism to the enemy king in won endings, pawn structure and passed pawns, and a tempo/progress signal), run through the protected training pipeline, which the restricted candidate generator (claude -p, agent.py and weights/ only, no Bash, no training pipeline) cannot produce. A self-contained first step a candidate could ship now — a single cheap king-tropism/centralisation endgame feature with a conservative fixed coefficient, fired for the side with a >= rook material edge in a low-phase position — is essentially a re-gated exp-0095 and is disallowed as tuning, so it is not recommended as a standalone experiment. Recommend running ./.venv/bin/python controller.py --release-check to produce a reproducible artifact of the current exp-0089 champion under the real clock, and holding for explicit user instruction. Uploading remains out of scope: the live submission is v3 (artifact sha prefix 55fec84c6dab, state.json status active) tied to this same exp-0089 champion, and this audit does not touch it.
